title: Relayr
desc: Relayr is an AI-augmented messaging app which can read your texts out loud and quantify aspects of the texts for set metrics.

title: HerbTantra
desc: An app prototype for HerbTantra, brand dedicated to harnessing the power of Ayurveda and age-old Indian kitchen remedies to provide holistic solutions for people of all age groups.

title: Moiré
desc: Every choice leaves a trace. But what happens when your own digital footprint starts hunting you? Can you ever truly delete your past, or do our traces always remain? Directed by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Heartware
desc: A short documentary shot and edited as an academic project, Heartware explores the relationship between technology and modern dating and how dating has evolved to be. Shot and Edited by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Zero Two
desc: A fan-art poster for Zero Two from Darling in the FranXX, rendered in a dark, gritty editorial style. Bilingual typographic layout combining English and Japanese, with a duotone red-on-dark palette and texture overlays.

title: Nissan 370Z
desc: A technical spec-sheet poster for the Nissan 370Z in the acid-green brutalist style. Inspired by streetwear graphics and Japanese car culture — dense layout, distressed halftone photography, and bold billboard typography.

title: Byomkesh Bakshi
desc: A noir poster for the iconic Bengali detective Byomkesh Bakshi. Black-and-white silhouette composition, dramatic street-light beam, and torn-paper collage elements. Bengali title typography hand-selected for authenticity.

title: The Wheel of Life
desc: A personal short video project exploring cyclical themes — time, repetition, and the rhythms that define our daily lives. Directed and edited entirely by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Kiwi Slices
desc: How expensive is Bengaluru, really? A youtube video produced during an internship, investigating the real cost of living in one of India's fastest-growing cities. Ideated, produced, and assisted shooting.

title: Barbie's Dreamhouse
desc: A miniature commercial for Barbie's Dreamhouse, produced as an academic project. Conceptualised, shot, and edited by Aritra Banerjee — combining practical miniature photography with a playful commercial aesthetic.

title: Darjeeling Diaries
desc: A short reel capturing the moments of my first trip with friends, ever. My first attempt at colour grading. Shot and edited entirely by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Gangtok Diaries
desc: A travel reel capturing moments from my friend's trip to Gangtok, Sikkim. Shot and edited by Aritra Banerjee as a personal documentation of the journey.

title: The Art of Noticing
desc: An observational short reel exploring the small, overlooked details of everyday life — the textures, sounds, and moments that pass by unacknowledged. Shot and edited by Aritra Banerjee for an academic brief.

title: Food Delivery Expenses
desc: A punchy, data-driven reel examining how much people actually spend on food delivery apps. Ideated and produced during an internship — concept, shoot assist, and production.

title: Astrology
desc: A humorous, opinionated reel on astrology — ideated, produced, shot, and starred in by Aritra Banerjee during an internship. Combines deadpan delivery with tight editing for maximum comedic effect.

title: Scapegoat
desc: An original audio drama written and directed by Aritra Banerjee. Starring as Denver Frost, the story unfolds through layered sound design and tightly scripted dialogue. Produced as an academic project.
meta: Academic Project · Written & Directed by Aritra Banerjee · 2024

title: Asche Bochor Abar Hobe
desc: A narrative audio piece written, narrated, and edited entirely by Aritra Banerjee, this is an attempt to express the emotions of each day of Durga Pujo through its distinct emotional soundscape.
meta: Academic Project · Written & Narrated by Aritra Banerjee · 2025

title: Mystic Musings
desc: An audio project about the depictions of mystical beings in pop culture. Starred in, Recorded, and Edited by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Museum of a Normal Person
desc: A 3-part mini-docu series about the lives and views of people attached to the craft of sourcing, curating and restoring trinkets, antiques and furniture, with an added academic angle. Cinematography and colour grading by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Mirage
desc: A music video based on SDG 6: Clean Water and Sanitation. Directed by Aritra Banerjee, who also sings and stars in it.
credits: Director: Aritra Banerjee. Also vocals and starring. A Group 1 Production.

title: Watched
desc: A magazine about how surveillance capitalism is affecting our lives. Designed by Aritra Banerjee.

title: Legaloid
desc: A guided legal-assistance platform concept for first-time legal seekers in India. Idea and pitch by Aritra Banerjee, developed with a group in a Design Thinking course.
meta: Design Thinking and Innovation, Sept 2026 (group project)
